issue_context.title: YEAR(0.9) returns NULL instead of 0 in NO_ZERO_DATE mode
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

When tidb is in NO_ZERO_DATE mode, year(0.9) returns null instead of returning 0 like mysql, Only when NO_ZERO_DATE mode is turned off will it return 0.
### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)
<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
```mysql
mysql> select year(0.9);
+-----------+
| year(0.9) |
+-----------+
|         0 |
+-----------+
1 row in set (0.07 sec)

```
### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
```mysql
mysql> select year(0.9);
+-----------+
| year(0.9) |
+-----------+
| NULL      |
+-----------+
1 row in set (0.04 sec)

mysql> set session sql_mode = "ONLY_FULL_GROUP_BY,STRICT_TRANS_TABLES,NO_ZERO_IN_DATE,ERROR_FOR_DIVISION_BY_ZERO,NO_ENGINE_SUBSTITUTION";
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.00 sec)

mysql> select year(0.9);
+-----------+
| year(0.9) |
+-----------+
|         0 |
+-----------+
1 row in set (0.04 sec)

```
### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)
```mysql
Release Version: v4.0.0-beta.2-2393-g3cfb984
Edition: Community
Git Commit Hash: 3cfb984211901c3416ec539658ac86d2cb64e81f
```
